body.label: Effect
body.html: Trigger: The enemy declares a single-target Action against you or an ally within 3 units. Response: On success, impose -2 on its Success Die for that Action; its target's space gains concealment afterward until the start of your next turn.

surges.html: Another adjacent space also gains concealment.
On a hit, suppress one ordinary accuracy bonus on that Action, to a maximum of 1.
